summary: NeuroSense Therapeutics Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 29, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing its Phase 2b PARADIGM study of PrimeC in ALS met its primary endpoint. The study showed a statistically significant reduction in TDP-43 levels versus placebo. This is a clinical trial results announcement, not a special-situation corporate event. There are no deal terms, no board recommendation, and no transaction structure. The filing is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer providing operational updates. No special situation category applies.
